EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows clear aromatic signatures: a strong ring breathing at 1009 and companion band at 1028 cm⁻¹, plus ring C=C stretches at 1593 and 1605 cm⁻¹, and an aromatic C–H stretch at 3081 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003). Crucially, a band at 1790 cm⁻¹ is consistent with an acid chloride/chloroformate C=O stretch, which fits phenyl chloroformate (candidate 1) but not aromatic chlorides without carbonyls. The absence of aliphatic C–H stretches (∼2850–2960 cm⁻¹) disfavors para-chlorobenzyl chloride (candidate 10), which contains a CH₂ group. Multiple bands in the 500–800 cm⁻¹ region can be assigned to aryl C–Cl/C–O modes and ring deformations, supporting an aromatic acyl chloride derivative rather than non-aromatic or fully halogenated candidates.
